CustomField.description: Tracks the lifecycle of a corporate matching-gift request against this transaction. Values sourced from the FQS_Match_Status GlobalValueSet so the staging GiftEntry mirror and canonical GiftTransaction copy stay in lockstep. Covers the whole workflow — Eligible (identified as match-eligible), Request Confirmed (submitted to employer), Received (match arrived, MatchingEmployerTransactionId set on this record), Declined (employer refused), N/A (no match expected). The FQS launcher and Apex match services stamp 'Received' when the matching-employer transaction is linked; Received is the terminal success state and pairs with MatchingEmployerTransactionId being populated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this gift stands in the corporate matching lifecycle. Leave blank or set to N/A if no match is expected. Set to Received once the matching-employer transaction has been received and linked.
CustomField.label: Match Status
